critique: Uniform flat slate frame at both t1 and t4 — no geometry, no duotone, no relief. Root cause: Fractal Type 2 (sparse/threshold) at Contrast 260 collapses to a near-uniform field; the mirror-tile of nothing is nothing, and Emboss over a featureless base outputs its neutral grey which the 45% blend mixes into the tint = the observed slate. The stack's structure is fine; the BASE generator degenerated.

suggestions.why: enriched card: type 13 = liquid marble veins — strong graphic structure that survives thresholding, poster-like shapes
260 crushed the field to one side; 180 keeps hard edges with both tones present
neutral brightness so black/white both survive for the duotone map
